name: Polycon International Ltd.
summary: Polycon International Ltd. focuses on the production and distribution of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) goods. Its diverse range of offerings encompasses PET bottles, jars, and preforms, alongside caps and lids. The company also fabricates linear low-density polyethylene (LLDPE) rotomoulded water storage tanks, as well as various PVC profiles and sections. The enterprise was founded on October 17, 1991, and operates from its headquarters in Jaipur, India.
